mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Verona City Hall. If you are out tonight, look for the International Space Station crossing the sky for 5 minutes starting at 8:17 PM, traveling from the direction of Belleville toward Fitchburg and Madison.

In city news, a former school staff member was arrested this past Friday for a 2019 incident. Additionally, road construction for the Aldi development enters phase two this week on Highway M, requiring a shift in traffic lanes.

There is plenty to do, including Hop Haus Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, you can visit the downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park or catch live music and more trivia throughout the area.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Friday, September 4th, they arrested a 34-year-old Madison resident following an investigation into an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie flavor of the day. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
